metrics.label: Estimated vault TVL
metrics.basis: Kong approximate overlap-adjusted snapshot; refresh time is not a synchronized valuation time

metrics.label: YFI in stYFI
metrics.basis: stYFI supply includes stYFIx; excludes unstaking balances and separate veYFI/LLYFI products

metrics.label: YFI in stYFIx
metrics.basis: subset of stYFI supply; never add to total stYFI supply

metrics.label: YFI supply in stYFI
metrics.basis: stYFI supply divided by total YFI supply

metrics.label: YFI price
metrics.basis: fresh Chainlink price from existing Stats feed

metrics.label: stYFIx reported APR
metrics.basis: current reward APR from Stats; not APY

metrics.label: Priced treasury holdings excluding YFI
metrics.basis: known priced subtotal; not total holdings or spending

metrics.label: Priced available operating holdings excluding YFI
metrics.basis: current priced holdings classified operating and available; commitments are not tracked

metrics.label: Resupply receivable including interest
metrics.basis: on-chain outstanding debt owed to Yearn; not DAO debt

metrics.label: Issued recovery shares: contract target shortfall
metrics.basis: max(shares × target PPS − accounted assets, 0); excludes unclaimed eligibility

metrics.label: Cumulative cash paid to claimants
metrics.basis: verified programme payments; separate from principal retired

metrics.label: Original principal settled
metrics.basis: settled principal includes exits below original principal; not cash paid

metrics.label: Unclaimed original eligibility
metrics.basis: unclaimed eligibility is separate from issued recovery shares
